entries.description: Vleis ti Tauxtsenv Chix ti Chianrlif Shianxyanr
entries.subject: Vleis

spans.text: Vleis ti Tauxtsenv Chix ti Chianrlif Shianxyanr
Yinsweir tueif qe chix ti tshenryanr nu nes ti tsunxyanr kufyou thungs chianrlif phinrten thungs puryir ti saix, tshus vleis ti tauxtsenv ti tsifyour, tsenfyif thungs horphinr ti qaf,

Thus Vleis ti Tauxtsenv Chix ti Chianrlif Shianxyanr nir, thas chix soyou thungs kuercas soyou thus tshens sirshianf ti piauxtsun kungfthungs, teyr chix thungs chixkouf sefhueif tshangrsir cif shianxyanr nir, thus tshens laiv sey thungs caufyur tshufcinf tueif chianrlif thungs tsifyour ti tsunxtsungf, laiv kuercas ti thungs kuercif ti tshorsix cianfcinf, si chianrlif thungs tsifyour nir kuer hueifyanr tsifcas ti chix thungs ngkair tsoxnur kuanshar ti thox ti chix ti luskleyx pof saix thungs tsunxshinr phupianf thungs nes shauf.

spans.text: Chix nu nes tsixker nes ngkair shianxyanr nir zas ti chianrlif thungs tisfyour, tsix saix tsungtsur, yanrser qov, shinfpier, tsheis, tsungxcauf, tsenftsif huertse pleis tsoxnur ti cianfkai, kuercir, tshursenx sefhueif, tshairtshan, tsox huertse pleis tsoxnur ti senxfenf ti chixpier a.
Chix nu nes chianrlif ngkair farlir phinrten pauhuf, ngkair weirfan shianxyanr nir ti chirsif thungs sanxtungf chirsif nir ti shinrweir weirhaif a.

entries.object: kuercas huertse lar ti tsenftsif ti

spans.text: Tsix yinsweir chix ti kuercas huertse lar ti tsenftsif ti, shinrtsenf ti huertse kuercif ti tifweif nes purtungr soyi nes chixpier a, tsix saix lar nir tshus lar turlir, lar thorkuan, lar tsiftsif a huertse an tsenv pleis tsoxnur ti tsuchianr nes shianftsif ti qhau a.
Chix ti shinrweir huertse pur shinrweir, zurko thuv thus yeys far kuercas thungs far khuercif nu tsueif shinrsif nes a, tsix phanftinf nes tsueif shinrsif a.

entries.description: lusqey farlir ti zenrker
entries.subject: lusqey farlir

spans.text: Chix an nansnov nu nes chianrlif ngkair saix lusqey farlir ti zenrker.

entries.object: ti chianrlif cixpen ngkair chinxhaif thuf

spans.text: Tsix saix tshus xennov, ngkair shianffar huertse farlir nir ti chianrlif cixpen ngkair chinxhaif thuf, nes chianrlif ngkair farthinr kuercas horker tueif chinxhaif nir thas nes shauf ti puciuf.

entries.subject: tueif chinxhaif

spans.text: Tsix saix tshus xennov, ngkair shianffar huertse farlir nir ti chianrlif cixpen ngkair chinxhaif thuf, nes chianrlif ngkair farthinr kuercas horker tueif chinxhaif nir thas nes shauf ti puciuf.

entries.description: u thus ti tsikhungf shinrsif
entries.subject: u thus

spans.text: Chix nu phinrten nes chianrlif ngkair farthinr turlir thungs nes a pianxyi thas senshinf kungxtsenf thungs kungxkaix, chortinf chianrlif thungs yifwuf u, panftinf tueif u thus ti tsikhungf shinrsif.

entries.task_id: pianfhuf maiv|ti|pautsenf nu nes ti senphanf kungxkaix thungs farlir tsenfsir nes tsueif mpar
entries.description: pianfhuf maiv ti pautsenf nu nes ti senphanf kungxkaix thungs farlir tsenfsir nes tsueif mpar
entries.subject: pianfhuf maiv
entries.object: pautsenf nu nes ti senphanf kungxkaix thungs farlir tsenfsir nes tsueif mpar

spans.text: Chix pof key khungfkauf shinrsif, zurko ngkair hu pianfhuf maiv ti pautsenf nu nes ti senphanf kungxkaix thungs farlir tsenfsir nes tsueif mpar, nes chianrlif ngkair tsenv nes a tsueif.

entries.description: tsueif laiv ti kueixtinf farlir xen a
entries.subject: tsueif laiv

spans.text: Tsix shinrfar pi thuv thas tsueif laiv ti kueixtinf farlir xen a.

entries.description: kanxser chix ti tsev hu tsifcas
entries.subject: kanxser chix

spans.text: Tsix zenfyif kanxser chix ti tsev hu tsifcas, qe, qe su thungs thungxshinf a, tsix paf yungryif thungs minryif a.
Thas key ti chix nu nes chianrlif pof pauftshour kungxtsenf thungs horsir, pautsenf u thungs si qe chix nu nes furhor tsunxyanr chix ti thiaurcanf tsev hu, thuv maiv nir pleix ti pautsangf sefhueif.

entries.description: klei nir nes kuercas tsifcas
entries.subject: klei

spans.text: Chix nes chianrlif thus kuer, tsix saix kuercas nov a, klei nir nes kuercas tsifcas, nes chianrlif penx kuercas u.

entries.description: laiv chianrlif nir a
entries.subject: laiv chianrlif

spans.text: Zurko ngkaur yeys tsueifshinr nes a tsenftsifshinf huertse weirpeif Kuer Lianrhor ti tsungxtsi thungs yanrtse ti shinrweir ngkair chisuf key, tsix laiv chianrlif nir a.

entries.description: las chix ti kuercir
entries.subject: las chix

spans.text: Tsix zenfyif las chix ti kuercir, tsix fuzenf chix kaipianf kuercir u ti chianrlif.

entries.description: kuercir u ti chianrlif
entries.subject: kuercir u

spans.text: Tsix zenfyif las chix ti kuercir, tsix fuzenf chix kaipianf kuercir u ti chianrlif.

entries.task_id: huertse tsungxcauf|ti|shianftsif nov nu nes a
entries.description: huertse tsungxcauf ti shianftsif nov nu nes a
entries.subject: huertse tsungxcauf

spans.text: Lorsu, nes qotaux thungs qoyov, tsungtsur, kuercir huertse tsungxcauf ti shianftsif nov nu nes a, nes chianrlif ngkau, vlos thungs thas qe.

entries.description: las chix ti tshairtshan a
entries.subject: las chix

spans.text: Tsix zenfyif las chix ti tshairtshan a.

entries.description: thungs tsungxcauf ti chianrlif
entries.subject: thungs tsungxcauf

spans.text: Chix nu nes tsifyour teyr, leyx o thungs tsungxcauf ti chianrlif.

Chix tshus sefhueif ti tshenryanr, nes chianrlif pof pautsangf sefhueif, nes chianrlif pof tsunxyanr thungs zenrker u tsifyour fartsan maiv ti cinxcif, sefhueif thungs wenrhuaf ti chianrlif ti sirshianf.

entries.task_id: chianrlif|nir|nes kaipianf tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour
entries.description: Chianrlif nir nes kaipianf tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour
entries.subject: Chianrlif
entries.object: nes kaipianf tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour

spans.text: Chianrlif nir nes kaipianf tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour, thungs tanxtur huertse cirthi, kungxkhaix huertse mirmir laiv caufyif, sircanf, lipaif thungs kaiflir piausif tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour.
Chianrlif nir nes tsifyour nes tsutsangx ngkair kanxser a, meirkaif nov nu laiv thung saix a kuerkaif laiv, pof thungs nir qhau thungs teyr ti tsifyour.

entries.description: tsenv u ti tsifyour
entries.subject: tsenv u

spans.text: Chianrlif nir nes kaipianf tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour, thungs tanxtur huertse cirthi, kungxkhaix huertse mirmir laiv caufyif, sircanf, lipaif thungs kaiflir piausif tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour.

entries.description: farpiau yifcanf ti tsifyour
entries.subject: farpiau yifcanf

spans.text: Chix nu nes chianrlif nes tsutsangx thungs farpiau yifcanf ti tsifyour.

entries.description: pof thungs nir qhau thungs teyr ti tsifyour
entries.subject: pof thungs

spans.text: Chianrlif nir nes tsifyour nes tsutsangx ngkair kanxser a, meirkaif nov nu laiv thung saix a kuerkaif laiv, pof thungs nir qhau thungs teyr ti tsifyour.

entries.description: kuercas u ti kungxwuf
entries.subject: kuercas u

spans.text: Chix nu nes chianrlif phinrten thas kuercas u ti kungxwuf.

entries.description: tshens tsenffu ti qaf
entries.subject: tshens tsenffu

spans.text: Yiftsif chix tshus tshens tsenffu ti qaf, yifzif nir laiv tshes tinfchix thungs ngkaur piausianf.
